Replies.Author: claude
Replies.Text: Recorded in Open Questions: join first (threads are the purpose; reviewer gets doc + thread history before each round), harness second, probes parked. In your zone — resolve when it reads right. On probes, one breath: a fresh agent is quizzed with questions generated from the CODE, answered only from the DOC — a thin or wrong doc fails the quiz even when its prose reads well.
